# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b96 — recognize real pollutant sensors only

Beta96 is a narrow correction to the fully tested **Beta95 room air-refresh and window-energy monitors**. All Beta95 wake/return, occupancy timing, safe outdoor ventilation, temperature-trend energy advisories, Greek/German/English announcements, and compact room-card behavior remain unchanged.

## Correct indoor air-sensor classification

Home Environment Manager's general room `air_quality` inventory also includes **illuminance (lux), sound/noise and air-speed** sensors. Beta95 treated the mere presence of *any* selected environmental sensor in this group as evidence that a room had an actual pollutant monitor, suppressing its time-based refresh reminders.

Beta96 resolves selected source entities against **Home Assistant's actual sensor metric and device class**. Light, sound and air-speed alone do **not** suppress the no-pollutant-sensor ventilation reminder. Genuine CO₂, PM, VOC, AQI, HCHO/formaldehyde and radon sensors do. A genuine pollutant sensor reporting unavailable is still considered installed, and an entirely missing selected source remains unknown rather than being declared absent.

The time-based monitor **never calculates an estimated CO₂/PM/AQI value** and is not a diagnosis of indoor air quality. A reminder still requires confirmed occupancy/wake evidence and favorable verified outdoor conditions.

## Verification and compatibility

Regression tests cover lux-only, noise-only, air-speed, real pollutant, unavailable CO₂, missing/unknown sources, the original Beta95 wake/return scenarios, and the complete Beta66–95 native window, PID, compressor, supply and Chromium card suites.

No physical controller, native relay, climate, frontend, notification template, setpoint or automation ownership code has changed. Only the new room monitor's HA sensor classification, its caller, version and release tests are modified.

## Install

Install **v0.6.0b96** through HACS prereleases, restart Home Assistant, and hard-refresh Lovelace if the dashboard is cached.
